name: Anthropic Mythos Leak Detection
description: Anthropic's next-gen Claude Mythos model was leaked via public data cache, described as 'step change in capabilities' with 'unprecedented cybersecurity risks'. Anthropic confirmed testing with early access customers.

name: Google ChatGPT Migration Tool
description: Google launched a tool in the March 2026 Gemini Drop that lets users transfer their AI chat history from other providers (specifically targeting ChatGPT) to Gemini.

name: Cursor $29.3B Valuation and Automations Launch
description: Cursor/Anysphere raised $2.3B at $29.3B valuation (Accel, Coatue, Google, NVIDIA). Launched Automations (autonomous cloud agents) on March 5. Acquired Graphite code review tool. 60% revenue from enterprise.

name: Google Jules GA with Gemini 3 Pro
description: Google's autonomous coding agent Jules exited public beta, now powered by Gemini 3 Pro (surpasses 2.5 Pro on coding). Available on subscription tiers: Pro (5x limits) and Ultra (20x limits). Gemini Code Assist now free for individual devs.

name: DeepSeek V4 Imminent Release
description: DeepSeek V4 is imminent — multimodal (text/image/video), ~1T parameters (32B active), 1M+ context. V4 Lite appeared on website March 9. Trained on Huawei and Cambricon chips. Tops LMSYS coding leaderboard alongside Claude 4.6.

name: Chinese Models 61% of OpenRouter Token Usage
description: Chinese AI models now account for 61% of total token consumption on OpenRouter. Top 3 by token volume are all Chinese: MiniMax M2.5 (4.55T tokens), Moonshot Kimi K2.5 (4.02T tokens), DeepSeek. Programming is 50%+ of all API tokens.

name: Zhipu GLM-5 Best Open-Source Coding
description: Zhipu AI's GLM-5 (744B MoE, 40B active) achieves 95.8% on SWE-bench Verified — highest open-source coding score. Trained entirely on Huawei Ascend 910B chips. MIT license. Zhipu IPO'd on HKEX Jan 2026, stock rallied 250%+.

name: Perplexity Platform Evolution
description: Perplexity evolved from search tool to full AI platform: Personal Computer (always-on Mac mini agent), Comet (enterprise assistant), API Platform (Agent API, Search API, Embeddings API), Market Research pilot. Premium data partnerships with CB Insights, PitchBook.

name: xAI $20B Funding and X Algorithm Integration
description: xAI raised $20B Series E (NVIDIA, Cisco, Fidelity, QIA). Grok will power X's recommendation algorithm — Nikita Bier called it 'the most important change ever made to X'. Doubling down on Grok Imagine video gen after OpenAI pulled back Sora.

name: Cognition Devin+Windsurf Integration Status
description: Cognition grew to 200+ employees after Windsurf acquisition. Valued at $10B+. But Devin and Windsurf products 'remain largely separate' as of March 2026. Cognition is a smaller player vs Cursor ($29.3B) and Claude Code.
